fallback.understand_task: Read the task again, slowly. What are you meant to find out?
fallback.activate_prior_knowledge: What do you already know about a task like this? Have you done something similar before?
fallback.next_step: What could you do first? Just think about the next small step.
fallback.similar_example: Think of a similar, easier task. How would you solve that one? Then try it the same way with your task.

answer_assessment.partly_correct: You are on a good way! Take another close look at your answer.
answer_assessment.not_yet: Not quite yet, and that is completely normal. A hint can help you on.
answer_assessment.unassessed: I could not check that just now. Would you like a hint, or try again in a moment?

fallback.praise: Great, you worked that out yourself!
fallback.comprehension_question: Tell me in your own words how you got to your answer.

opening.clarify: Tell me a little more: what are you supposed to do in this task?

redirect.small_talk: Hello! Nice to see you. Show me your homework and we can think it through together.
redirect.curiosity: What an interesting question! Ask a grown-up or look it up in a book. Do you have homework I can help you with?

errors.validation: Something did not fit. Please try again.
errors.sessionNotFound: This task is no longer open. Please start it again.
errors.noOpenQuestion: There is no question to answer right now.
errors.assignmentNotFound: This school task is not available any more. Pick another one or ask your teacher.
errors.rateLimited: Take a short break and try again in a moment.
errors.infrastructure: Something is not working right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

distress.title: Thank you for telling me.

distress.trustedAdult: Tell an adult you trust, for example someone in your family or your teacher.
